_comment: Deterministic copy normalization ruleset for fix-apply.mjs (Plan 217-06, D-13).
_note: Each rule is a text-node-only substitution. Rules that require semantic judgment are excluded — those route to the human queue (fix_class=judgment). Only mechanically-certain normalizations are listed here.

rules.description: Capitalize first word, lowercase rest for button/action labels (single-sentence, no proper noun).
Remove terminal period from short UI labels (<=5 words, not a full sentence). Adds period to descriptive copy that is a full sentence (>5 words, ends without punctuation).

examples.before: Enter your email address to reset your password
examples.after: Enter your email address to reset your password.

rules.description: Normalize section headings to title case (capitalize every major word, lowercase articles/prepositions of <=3 chars unless first word).
Normalize em-dash spacing to no surrounding spaces (house style: word—word, not word — word).
Replace triple-dot with Unicode ellipsis character (house style).

_judgment_boundary: Rules above are purely mechanical. Any substitution that could alter the intended meaning, change a proper noun, or affect technical terminology routes to fix_class=judgment and is excluded from auto-apply. The apply surface is text-node-only: never modify attribute values, never modify code/pre/kbd content.
